title: Analytics Engineer Role Instructions
instructionLines: The candidate is applying for the role of: Analytics Engineer.

sections.heading: Core Evaluation Areas Across Levels
lines: 1. Dimensional Modeling: Star schema, Snowflake schema, Slowly Changing Dimensions (SCD Type 1/2), and entity-relationship design.
2. Data Transformation & Orchestration: dbt models, DAG dependencies, testing (schema tests, custom data tests), and Airflow/Dagster scheduling.
3. Cloud Data Warehousing: Query execution planning on Snowflake/BigQuery/Redshift, partitioning, clustering, and compute cost optimization.
4. Semantic Layer & Business Metrics: Defining unified metric layers, data governance, lineage tracking, and data reliability.
